title: Dedication of the Wall

questions.question: Who were the priests and Levites that came up with Zerubbabel?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 12:1 (ESV): "These are the priests and the Levites who came up with Zerubbabel... Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra..."

questions.question: What event is celebrated in this chapter?
options: The dedication of the wall of Jerusalem
questions.correctAnswer: The dedication of the wall of Jerusalem
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 12:27 (ESV): "And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem..."

questions.question: How many great choirs gave thanks?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 12:31 (ESV): "Then I brought up the princes of Judah on the wall and appointed two great choirs that gave thanks."

questions.question: Who led the first choir?
options: Hoshaiah and half of the princes of Judah
questions.correctAnswer: Hoshaiah and half of the princes of Judah
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 12:32 (ESV): "Hoshaiah and half of the princes of Judah followed them."

questions.question: Who offered great sacrifices that day?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 12:43 (ESV): "And they offered great sacrifices that day and rejoiced..."

questions.question: Why did they rejoice?
options: For God had made them rejoice with great joy
questions.correctAnswer: For God had made them rejoice with great joy
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 12:43 (ESV): "...for God had made them rejoice with great joy..."

questions.question: How far was the joy of Jerusalem heard?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 12:43 (ESV): "...so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard far away."

questions.question: Who went before the second choir?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 12:36 (ESV): "...And Ezra the scribe went before them." (Wait, Ezra went before the FIRST one? Verse 36 is first choir. Verse 38 is second choir with Nehemiah. Correction: Ezra went before the first choir. Nehemiah followed the second.)

questions.question: What musical instruments were used?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 12:27 (ESV): "...with gladness, with thanksgiving and with singing, with cymbals, harps, and lyres."

questions.question: What were the chambers in the house of God for?
options: Storehouses for contributions, firstfruits, and tithes
questions.correctAnswer: Storehouses for contributions, firstfruits, and tithes
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 12:44 (ESV): "...men were appointed over the chambers for the storehouses, the contributions, the firstfruits, and the tithes..."

questions.question: Which king's command regarding the singers is mentioned?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 12:45 (ESV): "...as David and Solomon his son had commanded."

questions.question: Who followed the second choir?
options: Nehemiah and half of the people
questions.correctAnswer: Nehemiah and half of the people
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 12:38 (ESV): "The other choir... and I followed them with half of the people..."

questions.question: Where did the two choirs take their stand?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 12:40 (ESV): "So both choirs of those who gave thanks took their stand in the house of God..."

questions.question: Who was the high priest in the days of Nehemiah?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 13:28 mentions Eliashib. In 12:10-11, genealogy is listed. Eliashib was contemporary.

questions.question: In whose days were the priests and Levites recorded?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 12:22 (ESV): "...recorded in the reign of Darius the Persian."

key_verse_text: And they offered great sacrifices that day and rejoiced, for God had made them rejoice with great joy; the women and children also rejoiced. And the joy of Jerusalem was heard far away.
